style: Direct, athletic and transition-heavy; defensive solidity from a deep block springing world-class pace and dribbling in attack.
recent_form: Among the betting favourites; qualified comfortably and arrived deep in the FIFA top three under Didier Deschamps.

key_players.name: Kylian Mbappe
key_players.note: Elite pace and finishing; carries the attack and arrives in excellent condition.

key_players.name: Ousmane Dembele
key_players.note: Two-footed dribbler providing unpredictability and chance creation.

key_players.name: Michael Olise
key_players.note: Sharp passer and set-piece threat adding craft to the front line.

key_players.name: Jules Kounde
key_players.note: Quick, composed full-back/centre-back able to handle elite wingers.

key_players.name: N'Golo Kante
key_players.note: Veteran ball-winner providing balance and energy in midfield.

key_players.name: Marcus Thuram
key_players.note: Physical, mobile striker stretching defences alongside Mbappe.

historical_news: 2018 World Cup winners; runners-up in 2022, losing the final to Argentina on penalties.
Back-to-back final appearances established France as a modern superpower.
Deschamps in a long-running era as one of the most successful national-team managers.
Mbappe's transition to undisputed captain and global superstar at his peak.
Depth of attacking talent (Dembele, Olise, Doue, Cherki) is a defining storyline.

media_sentiment.label: positive
media_sentiment.summary: Consistently listed among the top favourites to win the tournament.
